name: Pharos Vault Rebalance Guard
description: Evaluates network gas, vault liquidity, and guardian native balance before approving execution

conditions.name: Network Gas Price Guard
conditions.description: Ensure current network gas price is at or below 3.0 Gwei

conditions.name: Vault Minimum Liquidity
conditions.description: Target vault or holder address must hold at least 50.0 USDC

conditions.name: Guardian Native Gas Reserve
conditions.description: Guardian or initiator address must maintain non-negative native gas reserve
